title: Docs and v1 acceptance round trip
lead:
User docs for every v1 command, and one end-to-end test that builds `adj` and
walks the acceptance round trip.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the dogfood run.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Milestone 5 and the acceptance criteria: all v1 commands work with no
third-party packages (C24), and the round trip works.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `README.md`: what adjudicate is, building `adj` with the in-repo cache env
  (C33), usage for every v1 command, and the license (GPL-3.0-or-later, C31).
- `cmd/adj/roundtrip_test.go`: builds the binary into `t.TempDir()` (for
  example with `go build -o` from a `TestMain`) and runs it with `os/exec`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In a fresh `t.TempDir()` store, running the built binary: `adj init` ->
`adj ask` -> `adj inbox` shows it -> `adj decide` -> `adj context` includes it
-> `adj check` reports it decided; then a second ask and decide,
`adj supersede` of the first by the second -> `context` no longer shows the
first and `show` still shows it with its history; finally `adj lint` exits 0.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Write `README.md` and add the round-trip test. The test inherits the cache env,
so its `go build` stays inside the repo (C33).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Run from the repo root after `. scripts/env.sh` (the in-repo cache env, C33):

- `go test ./...` passes, including the round-trip test.
- `go vet ./...` reports nothing; `gofmt -l cmd internal` prints nothing.
- `go list -m all` prints only `github.com/squalor-xyz/adjudicate` (no
  third-party modules).
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
